_note: The SCHOOL's moments (session P1, GDD 4.9.3 / 4.9.5; format in README.md). Senders: school:class_teacher, school:pe_teacher (with the creation answer 'A PE teacher spotted you' the one who did: condition origin), school:counsellor (the study counsellor, opo). Real yläkoulu life in grades 8-9: tests (the messages read SchoolSystem's tests and report cards), the Move! fitness measurement of grade 8, the winter sports day, the joint application with the counsellor and the spring party. Session L3a (the sort, docs/L3_SORT.md, user 2026-10-25): FEED messages that ask nothing, and one INVITATION (the group work at the library). The decisions about school are the School page's and the planner's (the meet-and-tests clash, the report card's evenings), never a teacher's question. Grades 8-9 only (lukio staff come in P2).

text: I hear you're training properly at {club} now. Ever since that school cross-country I knew you had it.
So the cross-country winner joined a club! I'm glad. That makes my week.
Your Move! fitness results came back from the autumn. The shuttle run: best in the whole grade. Not a surprise.
The Move! measurements are in. You beat the school's shuttle run record. The others want a rematch.
Winter sports day on Friday: skiing, skating or the snowshoe trip. Bring your own skis if you have them.
The winter sports day is coming: the 5 km ski trip or the skating. Hot juice at the lean-to shelter either way.
You looked very tired in class today. Sleep matters too.
You fell asleep in the history lesson. I didn't say anything. But I noticed.
Remember the {test_subject} test tomorrow. I know you had a hard session today, but an hour with the book helps.
{test_subject} tomorrow. Reading the summary pages is enough.
A busy week of tests. Make a plan, and don't leave it all to the night before.
This week has a lot of tests. Fit them around training as well as you can.
I wanted to say: your report card was really good this time. Sport and school together. Well done.
Your grades went up. I know how much you train. That's impressive.
Your grades dropped this term. Balancing school and training is hard. My door is open.
I'm a bit worried about your report card. The spring is a new start.
A 10 in PE, of course. But next term I want you to try the ball games properly too.
Your PE grade is the easiest one I give all year.
Grade 9: the year of the joint application. I'm booking a talk with you about your options: a sports lukio, a general lukio or vocational school.
Hi {name}, I'm booking talks with every ninth grader. You do athletics, I hear: the sports lukio options are worth a look.
Your average is close to the limit for the sports lukiot. This spring's grades count.
About the application: your sport points look good, but the grade average could decide it.
The joint application is open! Up to seven wishes, the one you want most first.
Reminder: the application window is open now. Put the place you want most first, not the one you think you'll get.

text.text: The spring party is on Saturday. Then summer. You've done well this year. See you in August.
Your last spring party here. I've enjoyed having you in my class. Remember us when you're famous.

text: Your group's history project is due on Friday. The others say they can only meet on {weekday} evening. Can you be there?
The biology group work: your group is waiting for your part. {weekday} evening, the library?

text: The Swedish oral exam is next week. Five minutes about your hobby. Easy for you: talk about running.
Oral Swedish next week. Prepare a short talk about something you love. I wonder what you'll pick.
Floorball tournament in PE next week. You're one of the captains. Pick your team wisely.
Next week in PE: the orienteering course round the school. I'd like you to help me set it.
Your class teacher said you look tired and stressed. My door is open: no forms, just talking.
I'm checking in with some pupils who have a lot going on. My door is open on Wednesdays.
